125.note: FREE cost=0 reel respin chain (ReMarks 'Respin N') opened by the ST140 TriggerNineRespin (pid 777, win 0). LockReels grows MONOTONICALLY across the chain (reels lock + accumulate collect symbols) and SymbolIndexToRewards accumulates positions — a lock-and-build buildup. It NEVER carries a win (WinCredits 0 on 5,719/5,719; PayoutIdToWinAmount {}; no payid, no residual) — the collected value is realised later in the NewFreespin (ST126), not here. Role 'respin' (a free reel extension of the triggered feature, M43/M279 family) rather than 'hold_respin' BECAUSE the winning settled feature is ST126 (freespin), not this ST: tagging it into the freespin family would mis-target freespin_dynamics's first-family-ST resolver onto this never-winning buildup instead of ST126. respin_dynamics (role hook) surfaces the buildup cadence (grant-rate / continuation / chain length via its zero-win eq0 band).

130.note: Single marker round per episode (ReMarks 'FinalNormalMinigame', cost=0), exactly one ST130 between the ST125 respin chain and the ST126 freespin (426/426 episodes order 125->130->126, ST130 run-length always 1). Carries the final accumulated lock/symbol state but NEVER wins (WinCredits 0 on 868/868; PayoutIdToWinAmount {}). Role 'state' (an empty/transition marker, not a settlement: a settlement role is a bare WinCredits that settles a feature — this round settles NOTHING into a win). No analysis is attached to the state role; it contributes 0 to RTP and needs no attribution rule.

126.note: GRANTED free-spin session (ReMarks 'Freespin N', cost=0) — the realising leg of the feature, opened by the same ST140 TriggerNineRespin via the ST125->ST130 build. Wins via NATURAL payline payids (PayoutIdToWinAmount populated; sum(payids)==WinCredits on 5,455/5,455, total 29,037,000 == server FeatureWin NewFreespin) — so NO attribution rule is needed (round_win_rule null). EXACT M275 ST126 freespin/NewFreespin signature match (BetAmount/CostCredits/StopSymbolsByCol/PayoutByPayline/PayoutIdToWinAmount/RewardLastNode/ReelSkin/ReMarks/ExtraRatio/GameplayTriggerType/WinCredits). Single trigger path (GameplayTriggerType constant 0; no scatter/collect-peak split) -> NO trigger_paths block. freespin_dynamics resolves the {freespin,hold_respin} family to this ST (the only family member declared).

trigger.note: The feature is opened by an ST140 paid spin whose ReMarks='TriggerNineRespin' carries payout id 777 with WIN==0 (a trigger marker that pays nothing; co-occurring payline pids on the same spin still pay normally). It opens a fixed feature chain: ST125 CreditsSymbolRespin (free lock-and-build respin chain, win 0) -> ST130 CreditsSymbolRespinSettle (single FinalNormalMinigame marker, win 0) -> ST126 NewFreespin (the granted free spins that PAY via natural payids). Per-robot the episode order is rigid (426/426: 125->130->126). Wins come ONLY from ST140 (base) + ST126 (freespin): sum(round WinCredits) = 44,620,500 + 29,037,000 = 73,657,500 == server TotalWin == server SummaryWin (exact). No additive no-payid collect-coin win channel exists despite SymbolIndexToRewards/CreditsSymbols being populated (WinCredits==sum(payids) on 100% of every ST -> zero _unattributed residual).

validation.evidence: Onboarded fleet-T2 (re-run) 2026-06-18, MANIFEST-ONLY (no new plugins, no machine_spec edit, no attribution rule). W1 ground truth (2 real v3 chunks, single md5 bucket 15fefe39/3bdf4421, bet=1000, 16 robots, ~91,000 rounds): 4 STs (140/125/130/126); roles derived from own fields. ST140=paid NormalCollectionSpin (cost=1000, CollectCount metronome ticks +1/spin, AccCredits accumulates; STRICT-REUSE the M275/M278/M279 paid_spin + collect_mechanic precedent). ST125=respin CreditsSymbolRespin (free cost=0 lock-and-build respin chain, LockReels grows monotonically, win 0 throughout; STRICT-REUSE respin_dynamics via the respin role). ST130=state CreditsSymbolRespinSettle (single FinalNormalMinigame marker, win 0; no analysis). ST126=freespin NewFreespin (granted free spins paying via natural payids; STRICT-REUSE freespin_dynamics via the freespin role; EXACT M275 ST126 signature). ECONOMY INVARIANT PROVEN: per-ST WinCredits==sum(PayoutIdToWinAmount) on 100% of rounds (40,000/40,000 ST140; 2,747/2,747 ST125; 426/426 ST130; 2,695/2,695 ST126 per chunk) -> NO _unattributed residual, NO collect-coin channel. sum(WinCredits)=73,657,500 == server TotalWin == server SummaryWin (exact). FeatureWin Times match per-ST counts exactly (NormalCollectionSpin 80,000 / CreditsSymbolRespin 5,719 / CreditsSymbolRespinSettle 868 / NewFreespin 5,455; BuffCollectionMap 192 = empty per-cycle marker, not in round stream). caveats: ROLE for ST125: classified 'respin' (free reel extension, M43/M279 family) NOT 'hold_respin' (M278 family) DESPITE the lock-and-build LockReels-growth signature, because the winning settled feature on M252 is ST126 (freespin), not ST125. freespin_dynamics._resolve_st_by_role returns the FIRST family-role ST in spin_types order; if ST125 were tagged into the {freespin,hold_respin} family it would shadow ST126 and the freespin mechanic view would mis-target the never-winning buildup. respin_dynamics (the respin-role hook) is the correct generic analysis for the buildup cadence. Note the structural distinction from M278: M278's ST160 hold_respin IS the winning settled leg (needed a SynthesizePayIdRule); M252's ST125 wins 0 and settles into ST126 instead.

ST125 lock-and-build sub-mechanics are parser_blind (framework-team, never fabricated): LockReels monotonic growth (reel-lock accumulation curve), SymbolIndexToRewards position map, chain-length->ST126-freespin-value relationship, CreditsBySymbol per-symbol collect — these need per-round run-length / per-symbol accumulation in the per-ST extraction layer. respin_dynamics surfaces every metric the frozen accumulators expose (grant-rate, continuation, chain cadence) and flags the rest parser_blind. Same boundary as M279 move-burst-length / M43 minigame node-list.

SINGLE trigger path: GameplayTriggerType is constant 0 on ST125/ST126 (no scatter-vs-collect-peak split like M275/M278), so ST126 carries no trigger_paths block — the freespin is reached only via the ST140 TriggerNineRespin (pid 777). If a re-sample surfaces a second entry path, add a trigger_paths discriminator then (extend on data, never by assumption).
